notes.title: ROADMAP – Third Milestone Ready ✅
notes.content:
Hello again, Animal Lovers! 🐾

We’re thrilled to announce that UPDATE III has just landed! 🎉
This is the third big step on our roadmap, packed with new features, improvements, and fixes that make running your shelter smoother and more fun than ever.

Your feedback continues to guide us forward. Every suggestion, every bug report, and every idea helps us shape Animal Shelter 2 into the game you’ve been dreaming of 💖

So, what’s new this time? Let’s dive in! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c54271764d69636ee7c468a1ae04bf605470843a.png


Additions and Changes:


 More accessibility for basic interactions! A new setting will allow you to go into an interaction mode just by clicking (and exit by clicking again), instead of needing to hold the button down. We've added new, dedicated containers. Now you can sort and keep most popular items (like medical supplies) in a dedicated and visually distinct container. 
 Equipment quality of life: you can now quickly move items from your hotbar to your inventory and back. Same works when interacting with containers! 
 No more getting lost in the shelter! You can now place waypoint markers on the shelter's map to make it easier to navigate in the game.

We’re also making progress on the black screen issue that some players encounter when trying to connect with friends. It’s a very elusive bug, but we’re getting closer to solving it – thank you for your patience! 🙏

 Fixed disappearing garage door when upgrading the garage.

notes.title: ROADMAP - Second Milestone Ready ✅

Hello again Animal Lovers! 🐾

Big news – UPDATE II has arrived! 🎉
This is the second major step on our roadmap, and we’re beyond excited to deliver more improvements, fixes, and features that bring your shelters to life in new ways.

Your passion, feedback, and creativity keep inspiring us to push Animal Shelter 2 further – and with every update, the world of your furry friends gets better, smoother, and more fun to manage. 💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/442f1e477aee2bf525d2f8e168db0356bf1ef0ce.png

 We heard you! Pets adopted by you no longer count towards pet limits.
 Take more pets on a leash at the same time! Starting today, a new leash is available in the shop that will allow you to take a walk with up to 3 pets at the same time!
 Taking all items from a delivery box (or any other future container) now uses also character's inventory, not only their item's hotbar.
 Sell your unneeded stuff! Bought chair that you don't like any more? When putting it in the trash it will be recycled instead and you will get back at some of the money you've spend.
 Photo camera now has zoom features and artistic filters.
 New shortcut to quickly take out the camera (default key is "V" for keyboard).
 The reputation limit has been lifted! You can get much, much, more max reputation. Also reputation stars in tablet will change colors depending on amount of reputation, e.g low reputation - bronze stars, higher reputation - silver stars.
 We've also added tips for most common questions to the loading screen (and even more tips are incoming!)
 


More changes, fixes and additions:

 For more convenience you can now set preferred temperature units also in the game settings.
 Never miss new encyclopedia entry: a small dot will appear on the encyclopedia button to indicate a new entry has been added.
 Improvements for placing items.
 Unlocked encyclopedia entries now appear on top, so they're easier to notice.
 Current temperature will now be shown in tablet weather widget.
 Popups won't be displayed while photo mode is active.
 Fixed outside cage doors in level 2 cages being closed with 'close inside cage doors' setting enabled.
 Fixed going back to main menu after host closing server.
 Added suffix "CLIENT" to user report summary when send by client.
 Added a setting that allows to specify whether item should be dropped when no suitable place is found.



We can’t wait to hear what you think of these updates – every piece of feedback makes a difference, and it helps us shape the shelter exactly the way you want it. 🐶🐱


And don’t forget.. This is just the second step of our roadmap… many more updates are still ahead! 🚀

notes.title: ISSUES WITH CO-OP MODE 🌐 — and how you can fix or avoid them
notes.content:
Dear Friends! 🐾

Thank you for such a warm welcome to our game Animal Shelter 2, your engagement truly means a lot to us 💛

Since the game's release, we have already made the first updates to improve your gameplay 🛠️, but we also see that some of you are reporting issues with our CO-OP mode in the game.

In our game, we use solutions provided by Steam, which means that every player who opens the game session becomes the Host and uses their own internet connection.

In practice, this means that the quality of the Host’s internet connection will determine the quality of the game for all players in that session 🌐

What does this mean in practice?

You can check your internet, for example, by using the analysis tool available at speedtest.net. The result will look like this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/6bc569e7e020f41a56f78c7cd2263f572e02ac0d.png


 If the Ping (also known as latency) is 100 or lower, it’s fine ✅
 But if the Ping is 200 or higher, symptoms of desynchronization with other players may appear - as you’ve reported (issues with delays, opening doors, inability to perform actions in the game).
 With a Ping over 300, gameplay can become very difficult ❌



You also need to remember that your distance from other players matters too!
If the Atlantic Ocean separates you from the game Host, the game may be less enjoyable than the Ping alone would suggest 🌍


We are currently working on fixes to the game that will make it easier for you to identify when something is wrong with the internet connection. 🔧

Thank you for being with us! 💛
We really appreciate your support  and we’re working hard to make the game better for you every day! 🐶🐱


Warm hugs,
Animal Shelter 2 Team

 Added grass in empty areas

 Fixed item offset after interactions (e.g., pouring food into a bowl)
 Fixed lingering interaction progress circle
 Stabilized multiplayer connection
 Improved overall game performance
 Fixed sliding NPCs

 Animals can now misbehave and run away from the washing station

notes.title: Our pets in Animal Shelter 2!
notes.content:
Hey there, dear animal lovers! 💚

We're getting really close to the big day — the release of Animal Shelter Simulator 2 is just around the corner, and we couldn't be more excited (and emotional) to share what we've been working on with you.

For months, our team has been carefully crafting every little part of this game. If you’ve been with us since the first Animal Shelter, you know one thing for sure: we don’t just make games about animals — we live with them. 
Most of our team members are proud pet owners, and our daily lives are filled with wagging tails, loud purring, muddy paws, and lots (and lots) of fur. 🐾
That’s exactly why every detail in Animal Shelter Simulator 2 comes from the heart.


🐶 Real Animals, Real Inspiration

Did you know… many of the posters you’ll see in-game (featuring adorable cats and dogs) are based on our very own pets? Yup — we turned our beloved furry companions into stars. 🌟 The models, posters, and even parts of the interface have roots in real-life stories, animals, and moments from our homes.

💌 This game is filled with tiny personal touches. From custom hand-drawn artwork by our wonderful artist Aleksandra, to sound effects created by Krzysztof, our audio wizard — every bark, meow, rustle or whimper has been carefully designed… and even recorded with the help of our pets!

notes.title: 🌦️ Seasons Are Coming to Animal Shelter 2! ❄️☀️🍂
notes.content:
Hello dear Animal Shelter Community! 👋
In our recent devlog, we dropped a few little “breadcrumbs” 🐾 hinting at a big new feature… and it’s time to officially reveal it! Animal Shelter 2 will feature a full season and weather system! 🌍 We’re excited to share with you the details so without further ado let’s break down what that means for you and your animals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c888cf964f0c84e08a815a7cec344657b6f911f5.png
🌙 Day & Night Temperature Changes
Temperature isn’t static — it changes throughout the day. At night it gets colder, and if animals are left outside their enclosures overnight, they’re more likely to get sick making it even more important to take good care of all the cuties in your shelter.

🌡️ Temperature Matters
We’re introducing a full temperature mechanic that affects:
-Outdoors — animals left outside in cold weather may get sick! 🤧
-Indoors — temperature per room depends on:
-Outside conditions
-Whether heating or cooling device is turned on
-If doors are left open 🚪
You’ll be able to place heaters and fans to regulate room temperature! 🐕 Each animal has its own optimal temperature range, and keeping them comfortable is part of your job. The temperature impacts the animals in more ways. It impacts their physiological needs as well as the level of their activity and behaviour❗

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/911e3abafb562999f0faa5c273d51ba7b12511a5.png
🍃 4 Seasons, Real Impact
Animal Shelter 2 includes all four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter — and they’re not just visual! Each season brings its own mechanics, effects, and events that will affect your daily shelter life. 🌦️

🧥 NPCs Dress for the Weather
Both visitors and employees will change clothes based on the season! ☀️❄️ Expect summer wear in the heat and winter coats in the snow. And that’s not all!! You can customize your employees’ uniforms to match your style! 🎨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/7739300929d0f8480c6443156fd5b06c93bfdbe0.png
☀️ Summer vs Winter Care ❄️
Every season comes with its own set of advantages and disadvantages and you’ll have to be thoughtful and prepared to embrace everything each season has to offer. Here are a few things to keep in mind: 😉
-In summer, be careful not to let animals overheat
-In winter, prevent them from freezing or catching a cold
-After snowfall, pets can get covered in snow — dry them off when they come inside or else they may get sick!
🍂 Autumn & Dirt, ❄️ Snow & Fun
-During autumn, wet conditions mean animals get dirty faster outside
-In winter, snow can stick to their fur and then melt indoors
You can even throw snowballs at other players for fun! ⛄

📺 Weather Forecast & Effects
Don’t worry! Although there are many things to keep in mind, we're coming with an extremely useful tool at your disposal. Weather forecasts will keep you notified about any temperature or weather change so you’re never caught unprepared!

Weather forecast system shows upcoming weather like rain or snow 🌧️❄️ which can further vary in intensity, including:
-Thunderstorms, lightning, puddles ⚡🌧️
-Heavy snowfall that needs to be shoveled away ❄️🧹
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/78b775cbb264831627adf76d23192ffb495bde7b.png
📉 Power Outages and Seasonal Interventions 🧹
Storms can damage the fuse box — if it breaks, you’ll need to repair it or part of the shelter will lose power and lighting! 💡 

Another downside of a storm is that you might find fallen branches to clean up 🌳.

New seasonal activities include:
-Raking leaves in autumn 🍁
-Shoveling snow in winter ❄️
-Helping with other clean-up efforts after weather events
🦆 Changing Wildlife & Fauna
The natural world also responds to the seasons and we’ve heard about some changes in the local fauna! 🤩
-Animals like frogs and snails start appearing when the temperature raises 🐌
-In spring, migrating birds fly overhead 🕊️
🛒 Seasonal Decorations & Items
Special season-themed decorations and items will be available in the shop — but only during their respective seasons so make sure to visit the shop from time to time and stock on your favorite decorations to help set the mood in your shelter! 🎃🎄🌸

🎨 Seasonal Main Menu
Here’s a sweet detail: the main menu reflects the last season you played in! It’s a small touch — but we hope it keeps you immersed in the shelter’s world 🌍💛

That’s it for now! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the new mechanic and all the changes it introduces. We’d also like to congratulate all of you who managed to guess the topic of today's devlog! We’ll be back soon with another one but until then — dress warm, stay cool, and keep the animals happy! 🐾💙

notes.title: Customization in Animal Shelter 2 🐾🎮

Hello, Animal Shelter 2 fans! 👋

Today we want to talk about one of our favorite features we're introducing to the game – customization. Here are the details! 👇🔥

One of the most important elements of the game is, of course, the shelter – the place that will become your home and the space for many furry friends. In Animal Shelter 2, we’re giving you full control over the shelter’s look. Players will be able to change:

notes.title: Sending animals to and from the shelter
notes.content:
Hello, Animal Shelter community! 👋

It’s time for another Animal Shelter 2 devlog and today we're thrilled to talk about some exciting upgrades on how animals move to and from the shelter in Animal Shelter 2. 

Compared to Animal Shelter 1, where these interactions were more limited, we've significantly expanded the ways animals can find new homes, receive care, and interact with volunteers. Let's dive into the details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/cef363878e58d9fea9cc430fb3e43c625d615538.png
Animal Shelter 1 🔍
In the original Animal Shelter 1, the options for handling animals outside of the shelter were fairly simple:

-Sending a car to pick up an animal.

-Sending a car to deliver an animal to its new home.

-Later, the addition of a park where players could take animals for walks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/009dd347eef74d6349b8fba6fdb1afa3cc698016.png
New Features in Animal Shelter 2 📝
We've taken everything from Animal Shelter 1 and greatly expanded the system in Animal Shelter 2. Now, players have more control and variety over how animals enter and leave the shelter:

-Animals still arrive via car, but now players can choose the pickup location from a map!

-Emergency rescues: Players can respond to intervention cases, rescuing animals directly.

-Adopters now visit the shelter in person instead of just receiving an animal by car.

-Medical care outside the shelter: Animals can be sent for medical examinations and treatments by selecting locations on the map.

-Pet returns: If an adoption was a poor match, there’s a chance the animal might be returned based on compatibility percentages.

-In Animal Shelter 2 there are additional people joining the stage- Volunteers! They can:
              -Take animals on walks.
              -Bring animals to their homes for a day of care.

-Open House Days: A brand-new feature where multiple potential adopters visit the shelter at once, increasing the chance of finding a perfect match.

-Individuals can bring in stray or abandoned animals, requesting the shelter to take them in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/88c3b019e972d97e1c9513a3f4f571cea6ca977b.png
A More Engaging Experience ❤️
From day-one, players can now walk animals in the park (just like in the first game, but now also in co-op mode!). These updates make Animal Shelter 2 feel more dynamic, realistic, and engaging, giving players more ways to interact with and care for their furry friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c32469ad10817bee0df8dcaeaa945db7182f567b.png
We can’t wait for you to experience all these improvements. Stay tuned for more devlogs and as always, don’t forget to let us know your thoughts on this topic! 🐶🐱

notes.title: The Process of Treating Animals
notes.content:
Hello Animal Lovers! 👋

Today we’d like to talk about something which was a hot topic for quite some time. Some of you were excited to hear more about it while others were a bit reserved. Today we’ll give you more details about 🌡️ illnesses and treatments in Animal Shelter 2.

In our game, animals arriving at the shelter may exhibit symptoms indicative of an ongoing illness. Players will need to keep a close eye on the health of their furry residents, as health deterioration can be noticed in various ways—such as a decreasing health bar, lethargic behavior, or detailed notes in the animal’s medical chart.

📝 Diagnosing Illnesses

The medical chart will serve as the player’s primary tool for identifying an animal’s condition. Suggested tests will be listed on the chart, guiding the player toward a diagnosis. 

Some of these tests can be conducted directly at the shelter, such as collecting stool or blood samples. However, for more advanced diagnostics—like X-rays or ultrasounds—the player will need to send the animal to a specialized facility.

Once the tests are completed, the medical chart will update with a confirmed diagnosis and details about the required treatment plan.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0c11df4e4f1f962380eb943b3a42d1a6432554ad.png
😷 Types of Illnesses

In Animal Shelter 2 we can distinguish 2 main categories of diseases you and your animals will face:
-Fully Curable Illnesses: Examples include common colds or pneumonia. Treating these conditions will involve administering specific medications or combinations of drugs at proper intervals. Successful adherence to the treatment schedule will lead to full recovery.

-Chronic Conditions: Chronic illnesses, such as persistent lung disease, cannot be completely cured. However, proper medication can ensure the animal remains in excellent condition. Players will need to provide ongoing treatment, sometimes requiring daily administration or even overnight stays in the shelter. The animal’s well-being will depend on consistent care.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/6cac3bf9ba689186056e27660bc4879c1e09ed9a.png

⚠️ Challenges in Treatment

The illnesses come with some additional issues players will have to deal with both during the treatment and the adoption process. 
-Medication Accuracy: giving incorrect medications will hinder progress, leaving the animal weak and potentially worsening their condition.
-Chronic Condition Perks: animals with chronic conditions may have additional traits that make them harder to adopt. Some conditions, like blindness, don’t require treatment but will still affect the animal’s quality of life.
-Specialist Equipment: certain illnesses may require equipment unavailable in the shelter. Players will need to arrange for the animal to receive care at an external facility.

☣️ Infectious Diseases

In some cases, illnesses may be contagious. To prevent outbreaks within the shelter, players can use isolation units to separate sick animals from their healthy companions. Strategic use of these facilities will be essential to maintaining the overall health of the shelter population.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/51daa5400ffca0437933304bef5646c1fe73fd28.png
 💭 Final Thoughts 
Our aim with the animal treatment system is to create an engaging, realistic gameplay experience that challenges players to manage resources, time, and care effectively. Whether nursing a puppy back to health or providing lifelong support to a chronically ill cat, players will form meaningful bonds with their virtual animals while honing their skills as shelter managers.

What do you think of this approach? We’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions!

That’s it for today! We can’t wait to hear from you. If you’d like to meet other players interested in our game, look for a partner to play multiplayer or stay informed about the upcoming posts join our discord and add the game to your wishlist! 👇

Stay healthy!

notes.title: What has changed? AS1 vs AS2 Prologue
notes.content:
Hello Animal Lovers! 👋

We're thrilled to announce that Animal Shelter 2 Prologue is just around the corner with a release date set for September 13th! 🎉 

To get you ready for the big day, we’ve put together a list of exciting new features and improvements that set it apart from the original *Animal Shelter*. We can’t wait for you to dive into the game and experience all the amazing changes! 🐾


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d4d2127e7412dae1a1869b5ba590c176132dfb11.png


🌟 All-new graphics
The visuals have been significantly upgraded, especially for the animals, who now look more realistic and adorable than ever before!

🏠 Enhanced shelter customization
While you can no longer move buildings, you now have much more control over customizing your existing shelter. Change walls, ceilings, floors, and even expand some rooms to suit your needs!

👥 Other characters
Meet NPC workers  and adopters  who visit your shelter. This brings a new layer of interaction and managing people around you.

🤝 CO-OP mode
Yes, you heard that right! Animal Shelter 2 Prologue introduces multiplayer co-op mode, so you can run the shelter with your friends or alone!

🚑 External services
Need a special treatment for an animal? Now you can send them outside the shelter for surgeries or treatments, adding more depth to the care management system.

🗺️ 2D world map
Explore the world outside the shelter! Use the new 2D map to discover events, activities, and interventions waiting for you and your animals.

🚓 Intervention missions
Now you can personally go on rescue missions, entering different locations to help animals in need. These locations are partially procedurally generated, so each visit offers a new experience.

🐶 Puppies and kittens included
No more waiting for DLC! Puppies and kittens are available from the start in Animal Shelter 2 Prologue, ready to melt your heart.

🐕 Your own pet
You can now have a personal pet that follows you around the shelter, keeping you company as you manage your daily tasks.

📝 More advanced mission system
In Animal Shelter 2 Prologue, the missions are more complex and varied.

🧠 Improved animal AI
Animals in the game are now more realistic. They have their own behaviors, needs, and desires. They interact with other animals and might show unwanted behaviors that you'll need to correct, making animal care more demanding.

🩺 More involved animal care
Caring for animals in Animal Shelter 2 Prologue goes beyond just physical needs. You’ll also need to manage mental and behavioral issues before the animals are ready for adoption. Every pet requires a unique approach, adding depth to the gameplay.

🌗 Day and night cycle
The game now features a dynamic day and night system, which not only changes the aesthetics of the shelter but also affects daily tasks. 

📱 Tablet replaces the camera
You no longer need a separate camera to take photos. All images and documents are now managed through a tablet, which serves as your "command center" in the shelter, simplifying the management process.

💉 Expanded healing system
The healing system is now more detailed. Some animals will require long-term treatments, while others might need specialized care outside the shelter. You may also encounter animals with chronic health issues that require ongoing management while they stay in your care.

👵 Older animals
The game now includes older animals, which have their own unique traits. They may tire faster, require more care, and can be harder to adopt out. These elderly pets add a new level of challenge to shelter management.

👗 Animals can wear clothes and decorations
You can now dress your animals in clothes and decorations not only during photoshoots but anytime. This adds a personal touch to the shelter, making it even more unique and heartwarming.

🐾 DLC features from the original game are now included in the base game
Features such as walking animals on leashes, using the tablet for management, and animals running freely around the shelter are now part of the base game. You can also place animals anywhere in the shelter, not just in designated spots as in the first game.

🧹 Better shelter cleaning system
The cleaning system has been improved.

🎁 More perks and new features
The game introduces other smaller yet important improvements like the auto-disappearance of empty delivery boxes, new gameplay-impacting perks, and overall adoption system improvements.

[previewyoutube=u1Azx7_YBlE;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re incredibly excited for you to experience all these new features in Animal Shelter 2 Prologue when it launches on September 13th! 🐾 Add the game to your wishlist now and join us on Discord for the latest updates!

notes.title: Interventions
notes.content:
Hello Animal Shelter Managers! 👋

We’re back with another devlog and this time, just as promised we’ll tell you more about interventions! 🤩 It’s a new mechanic introduced in Animal Shelter 2 which you’ve been curious about so we’re even more happy to share some details with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/051b1482e85079c6d991bb31ec258d1aecd21372.jpg
There is an important difference between an animal rescued in an intervention and simply taking an animal- intervention can be canceled before the car leaves the garage and during the rescue which will result in not taking the animal in❗

As you know, animals coming to your shelter are rescued one way or another. This event, although relatively simple, will give you an opportunity to take matters into your own hands. Sometimes it’s going to be a cat stuck on a tree, other times you’ll have to saw through the bars where animals got stuck. 🌳 Don’t forget that simple gestures like some food or petting will most definitely be appreciated by the rescued animal. 😹

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/b8aa37cb73941aa8f2aac5dc19851d5e37072e25.jpg
Players will be notified via mark on the tablet map in the place where you send your car to pick up the animals. But before you’re able to go you’ll have to meet some criteria such as having all the necessary equipment to rescue the poor fellow, having an available car and empty space in your shelter. 📝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/9d24e1a3864f21db555c2ed0657cd02cf7a74bbf.jpg
There will be three unique locations in which the interventions will be able to take place- suburbs, city center, park. But the places in the locations are randomly generated which will add for a more unique experience every time you help an animal! 🐕

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/a8d72c16d16531741b7e8bdd976362aa74974488.jpg
There are some types of interventions which are available for all the locations and some assigned to particular places. Let’s take a closer look at them, shall we? 👀

All Locations
- taking animals down from heights
- rescuing animals from rubble
- finding lost animals

Park
- feeding local animals (we don’t take the animal back to the shelter, we only help them to live)

City Center
- freeing animals whose heads got stuck between bars

Suburbs
- animals attached to an objects and left without care

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/51cc07a975a8c17d0048b8098dd41437ae3beed5.jpg
We’d love to hear your opinions on this mechanic. Do you like it? Will you prefer to do interventions or take in the animals without having to save them first? 🤔 Let us know in the comments! Don’t forget to join our discord and to add the game to your wishlist to get notified about every upcoming news! 💪

notes.content:
Hello Animal Shelter Fans! 👋

As promised we’re back with another topic we’d like to introduce in more details- the shelter upgrade and customization systems ⬆️Most of these features are novelties in comparison to the Animal Shelter 1, that’s why we’re even more excited to hear your opinions about these mechanics! 🤩 Make sure to let us know your thoughts in the comments!

Buuuut, before we get to the devlog, the premiere of the free Prologue for Animal Shelter 2 will take place soon! So don't miss the release date and you can add it to your Wishlist now!👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2887780/Animal_Shelter_2_Prologue/

Shelter levels 📝
There are five levels in total for all the rooms and the shelter, the first which is essentially a “level 0” is the neglected building you’re clearing to reach level 2- an operational shelter. An important thing to remember is that in order to be able to raise the level of your shelter, you’ll first have to raise the level of all the available rooms.

You might be wondering “Hey, can I just upgrade the rooms as I please?” Yes- you can put your effort into upgrading your rooms in any order you want but there's an additional factor- ⭐shelter reputation. Once you reach a certain level of reputation you’ll meet the criteria to be able to upgrade your rooms to the next level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/ae4d9499df28a09d7dc3fcd122629712baf3bcf7.png
But what exactly changes once you raise the level of the room and shelter? There are various possibilities. Let’s start with the shelter level, shall we? Each level of the shelter grants you some visual upgrades such as the looks of your shelter, adjacent terrain, lawns etc. They also grant you new decorations or alter the already existing ones. What's most exciting though is that these upgrades may also come with new features for your rooms! 😍  One example is gaining additional cars in your garage. 

It’s similar in case of room upgrades. While all the upgrades grant you nicer looks of the rooms, some of the upgrades increase the size of a room or unlock additional space which was previously taken, giving you more possibilities. 👍

We’ve prepared some cool graphics to show you how your shelter's looks can change if you put some effort into it! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eacdf756969858fdc000d6fa44122ca27be8a81b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/5ba17900e97e01e6dd9e12451bc0e69a72b0baef.png

Painting 🖌️
One of the features available to make your shelter fit your vision is to alter the looks of the surfaces in it. You can paint:
1. Walls
2. Ceiling
3. FloorsWe’d like to help those of you who don’t want to spend too much time on decorating your shelters to have nicely looking buildings. That’s why we’ve prepared some presets which will be at your disposal. ❤️‍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/68d1cc0d9f6861ed01bb28f6062189dc36537a99.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c72ffe167c55d6084623a41b6947af8b43ec7652.png

For others who would like to put more effort into making the shelter more customized, we’ve got you covered. We’re providing you with the possibility to mix the colors and materials. We’ve also prepared more fancy materials adding textures or some shape to them! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/5fb4a33cc7ad5dcbab4e8a2c0c204acadd6b7b9f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/45fa0a0bab15c286be660395e312afdd7493d226.png

Furniture 🪑
We’ve introduced a reworked system of placing furniture in the first person camera. It’s similar to the one used in case of smaller items but adjusted so that it doesn’t compromise your view. 👀 (the held furniture turns into a blueprint in your hand). To allow more precision a grid also appears which optionally can be snapped to while placing the objects. This way you’ll always be able to place your furniture perfectly where you want it. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/b03c1740054b0f8dc621b534bcfee6e0771ea79b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c2781770b47bca0eee85b968be9c08e8c247f7fc.png

Items 📚
We’ve added all sorts of small items to allow you to make your shelter even more personal. We’re positive that the addition of books, flowers, posters and other decorations will make each of your shelters truly unique and exciting places. Keep in mind that some of the decorations are dedicated to certain areas like walls. 🙂

notes.title: Animal adoption process
notes.content:
Hello Animal Shelter Enjoyers! 👋

Today as we promised we’ll discuss the adoption process in more detail. 📝 In Animal Shelter 1 the adoption process was fairly simple and followed two basic criteria:

-the animal had to have it’s needs satisfied
-you should pick the person whose living conditions and preferences of the animal’s behavior and features matched those of the animal looking for new home

Each animal had approximately the same number of potential owners and your job was to pick the perfect match. 👍

Animal Shelter 2 went a few steps further. Making the entire adoption process more developed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/c1823d13106b2e93afe16d705e52306b36ecdca2.png
📷 It all begins with a photo, just like in Animal Shelter 1 but unlike the part 1, this time the picture matters. Cute, cool looking pictures will receive an additional bonus to the adoption announcement’s effectiveness. On top of that, in Animal Shelter 2 your animals will be able to wear cute clothes in the entire shelter, not just in the photo booth. 😻

🐶 The overall status of the animal looking for adoption will keep playing a vital part in finding potential owners. A well-fed, healthy and happy animal will have an easier time finding more people interested in taking that cutie home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d023c4de05af07a60646e6c426f5dd6ec61aa909.png
Perks and features. This is the most important aspect influencing the adoption speed. Just like in real life, younger animals are more likely to find new homes than their older pals. This will become one of the main adoption challenges as animals in Animal Shelter 2 come in all spectrums of age. Will you be able to find your seniors carrying owners?

Perks on the other hand will help to make every animal truly unique, giving your pupils additional features of character. There will be all sort of perks but here are a few examples of what to expect:

Joyfull- happily greets the player, this exuberant animal will often want to play

Clingy- very often comes to the player and follows him around, extremely social

Calm- bonds easier, this animal has easier time finding new home

Other kind of perks will emphasize the overall status of the animal. A good example of such perks would be:

Elderly- This animal has some years under the belt which is evident looking at its fur. It gets tired quicker and has a harder time looking for a new home.

Youngster- cute, enquiring and easily likable. Those animals will be more likely to get adopted quickly.

There will also be some perks referring to animal’s illnesses, which will make taking care of the animal harder. Essentially making them less interesting targets for adoption. 

📣 If you feel like your adoption announcement needs some help, Animal Shelter 2 provides you with additional tools aiming to increase the amount of people interested in adoption. Additional text in the announcement, extra effective range, or even advertisement in the radio are at your disposal but don’t forget that each of them will require additional funds. Another feature which impacts the announcements’ visibility are the events happening on map but this is a topic for another devlog!

notes.title: Animals pt.1
notes.content:
Hello Animal Lovers! 👋

Before we dig into the actual devlog, we need to inform you that today’s topic- the in-game animals will be split into two parts because of the sheer amount of information we’d like to cover. 📝 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/610537fb6727d05b1fcdfd72401a354f0481b803.png
Today, we’ll talk about what animals will make their appearance in Animal Shelter 2, what are the ways of acquiring them to your shelter, their preferences and adoption. In part 2, likely in 1 to 3 months time, we’ll tell you more about their health, possible health issues, means of treatment and what impact on animals and their future owners chronic diseases will have. 🤯 As you can see, there’s a lot to talk about so without further ado, let’s dig into it! 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/9bdf4afde4f11f81eb26e4b6ee345cbc829b840a.png
For quite some time you’ve been expressing just how much you want to have not only the cute, lively puppies and kittens 🐈 as alternative to the adult animals but also older, calmer senior animals. Today we’re happy to officially confirm- in Animal Shelter 2 there will be animals of all ages! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/062b6f04f9671ba4722a427eac20cc341dde1a6b.png
Animals in your shelter 🐶
As we’ve already mentioned, there are multiple ways the animals can arrive in your shelters. Recently, we’ve described the most common one- sending a rescue car via your tablet. This is the mechanic that players who took part in the Playtest are familiar with. 🙂 Another way is to carry out an intervention. There are multiple different causes for an intervention like for example a kitten stuck in some place like a drain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/072571d9e09bbab96a8402618607bc2b0869784e.png

Once the animal arrives at your shelter it will require their own private space. Just as it happens in Animal Shelter 1, the animals are hungry and thirsty after arrival so don’t forget to show them some love and feed them well. Some belly scratches afterwards wouldn’t go unnoticed as well. ❤️‍ 

At this point, there are some additional activities which would be reasonable to do as soon as possible. One of those is taking a blood sample for a check up. After all, a neglected animal is likely to have a disease of some sort and it’s only for the best when it receives the medical attention it needs as soon as possible. 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/4387d8fbf83d707f4794a4a741b63ab1316b20ee.png
Every animal which lives in your shelter, whether it’s an energetic youngster, adult or senior, will have their preferences in many aspects such as favorite toy, the best petting spot or food. 🥫
By following those preferences you’ll receive bonus points to the animal's respective status meters. For example, playing with a doggo using its favorite toy will make its fun status rise quicker. 🐕 And while ignoring this little piece of information while playing does not bring any negative consequences, 

it’s very important to keep a close track of all the animals’ feeding preferences because feeding an animal food other than the preferred one may lead to some diseases- usually because of their food allergies. 😿

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/6af2e1468ecb811f4eb9603018bc4f1a8a4bbbcd.png
Adoption 👱
As you might have already guessed, the chance for an animal to get adopted quickly will be impacted by various factors. The most important one being the age. Usually kittens and puppies will be able to find new homes much quicker than the senior animals, who’ll need more time before finding their new carrying owners.

Another important factor altering the chances of adoption are the chronic diseases but if you’re interested in this topic you’ll have to look forward to part 2 because this is the end of today’s devlog.

Before you go, make sure to leave us a comment to let us know if you like the showcased content. We read all of your feedback and your voice is really important to us. 💬

notes.title: The Tablet
notes.content:
Hello Animal Fans! 👋

Welcome back to the new devlog from our Shelter! We’re excited to be able to see you again and today, we’d like to show you a tool which some of you may already know from Animal Shelter 1- the tablet. 🖥️ In Animal Shelter 2, on top of the well-known functions there will be some novelties so let’s take a look at it’s functionalities, shall we?

Map 🗺️
This functionality will have significant, not to say fundamental importance during your gameplay because using it will allow you to pick up animals which will end up in your shelters. 🐶 You’ll be able to either remotely send a car or even go personally to find the place this animal got stuck in and rescue it! 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/a182cffaa02936752bda18150fe8cb1573541ca1.gif
Shelter managing 👉
In the previous part, the building function was in a different game level than a tablet. Currently, we’ve implemented this system in the tablet to make developing your shelters easier. 👍 This tab will allow you to inspect the condition of each individual room (are there any trash to take out, is it decorated well, etc.). On top of that, it’ll allow you to buy/sell/move cages, manage your employees and even change the name of your shelter! 👱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/b8519140bf0f828a31f38e0c4885476fa7cddc79.png
Animal list 📝
List of all animals currently living in the shelter and information about each of them. This system will be a familiar tab for all Animal Shelter 1 players but with a new, refreshed graphics. 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/d6b98b36ed26c7c400a4d42981fb5a1c68d1025e.png

Image gallery 🖼️
A tab where all the pictures of your cute animals will be stored! ❤️‍ Use them well to create incredible adoption announcements that will catch the future owners attention!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/36b0377158578895318e73ee28be28582fe90c47.png
Camera 📷

That’s right! In Animal Shelter 2 the camera is a function of your tablet! 🔥 This will free an extra space in your inventory and make the tablet an even more helpful and versatile accessory! 💪

History of notifications ❗
In this tab, you’ll be able to check all the notifications in case you don’t remember if you’ve tended to all the important events in your shelter! 📝

Reputation and shelter ranking 🥇
Check the popularity of your shelter and earn prizes as you rise in the rankings! 🤩

notes.title: Day and night cycle
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We’re thrilled to welcome you to the 2nd devlog from Animal Shelter 2! Today, we’d like to talk about another feature which was frequently mentioned and asked for and it’s the ☀️ day&night 🌑 cycle. As we’ve already explained, due to the limitations of the game’s code, we weren’t able to implement this feature before but with the Animal Shelter 2 that’s not an issue anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/77c86f2e2c954783331797ba485d6b56d42717fe.png
Today, we’ll explain this system in more detail and give you examples of its impact on other in-game mechanics! 🔥 We’ve got a lot to talk about so let’s take a look, shall we?

👱 Employees
As we’ve already announced, the game will offer you a possibility to hire workers helping you to take care of daily activities at your shelter. Their help is available only during the day because when the shift is over, they’re heading home to have some rest and prepare for the following day! 👍

➕ Curing Animals
A change also occurs in the process of tending to sick animals. With the introduction of day and night cycle the time animals need to get well will be slightly longer than in the Animal Shelter 1. On top of that, treatments will require giving medicine every few hours at fixed intervals, once a day etc. in order to help your animals get better. 🐶

🚶 Adoption
This brings us to one more significant change- even if you decide to stay at the shelter for night because of the treatment of a particular animal, before it gets well you’ll not be able to arrange any adoption meetings for this animal before it gets well.

🐱 Animals
Finally, the Animals. Your cute pupils will also not stay indifferent to the passage of time. Because of the fact that during the night the only personnel allowed to stay at the shelter is the owner, the animals will require to be taken care of in the morning. Fill in their food and water bowls, clean up the enclosures and give them some love and affection to shake off the lonely night. Don’t worry, the employees will also come in the morning filled with energy to help you get the place tidied up. 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e8ea15a9f432a314aba3e1d3271e9aee95445f3a.png
As you can see, the day&night cycle will affect many different aspects of the game. Starting with the looks of the environment, through the employees' availability to even the mood of the animals at the shelter.

Keep in mind the game is still in development and we’d love to hear your opinions and ideas on the topic of today’s devlog! 🔥 Make sure to let us know on discord 👇 and add the game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss on any upcoming info!

notes.title: First devlog!
notes.content:
Hello Animal Shelter fans! 👋

We’re extremely happy to see you in the first monthly devlog from Animal Shelter 2 🐶. Once again, we’d like to thank you- this game is in development for and because of you all. The overwhelming amount of feedback and ideas made us take a step forward and implement a new, better ground where we’ll be able to implement them! 💪 We hope that you’ll follow each of our devlogs closely and let us know your opinions on the topics we present. We’ll surely pay close attention to your responses to make sure the game is up to all your expectations!

This month, we’ve prepared three topics, two of which are completely new mechanics! 🤩

☀️ New day & night cycle 🌑

The alteration of this system, as well as an option to be able to pick up stray animals off the streets were frequently mentioned on multiple occasions by our community. 💬 Unfortunately, we weren’t able to introduce these changes in the Animal Shelter 1 due to the old code but with the new game it’s not an issue anymore!🔥 We’ve already finished implementing a fully operational, new day and night cycle which you’ll be able to enjoy in the upcoming playtest 👍. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e8ea15a9f432a314aba3e1d3271e9aee95445f3a.png
2d in-game map 🗺️

You’ve read it right! We’ve introduced a 2d map which is already partially functional. It’s going to be further developed but you’ll be able to use some of its features in the playtest. 😀 We’ve been wondering if you’ve got any idea which new feature yet to be revealed is the introduction of minimap connected to? Let us know in the comments! 😼

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/69b4d930f83950809a6431dcbef021c7c97430cd.png
New, improved animal models and animations of animals and the petting system 🐈 

The animals were given much, much love and have undergone a complete metamorphosis 🔥! In Animal Shelter 2 we’ve focused on perfecting the cats and dogs which were given some suggestions to alter their looks in Animal Shelter 1. 

The animals are various, have fluffier fur and their physique fully differs in comparison to each other! 🐕 We’re also giving some love to the animations of their behavior and interactions with both other animals and people! 😍 The petting mechanic has also undergone a massive upgrade and now it should be able to satisfy even the most demanding animals (and animal fans). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/6f4846c980fbfe42936774f9a0e0da6bdd2d9be8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/2c0c22dc7bae5b62d0012b3f63d02d52db1c627b.png


Unfortunately, that brings us to the end of today’s devlog. We can’t wait to hear your opinions about the presented topics! 💭

 If you enjoyed reading it and would like to support us then consider adding Animal Shelter 2 to your wishlists on Steam 👇. 

Don’t forget to join our discord community where you can meet other members of the Animal Shelter Community. 

We’d also love to remind you about the possibility to sign up for the upcoming Animal Shelter 2 Demo Playtest! If you’d like to experience the AS2 first hand, all you have to do is to visit games’ main page on Steam and sign up. It’s that simple!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/04aaee60c314cb7eba5ee7af51639e5cfb0ab764.png 



See you soon,
Animal Shelter 2 Team!
